nphi.title: ZikaPLAN – Zika Preparedness Latin American Network
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK); Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Instituto Butantan; LSHTM; Erasmus MC; ITM Antwerp; Universidad del Valle; Swiss TPH
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 consortium researching Zika virus complications and building a sustainable Latin American research network for emerging-disease preparedness. NPHI-type partners include Fiocruz, Cuba's IPK and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: China CDC – IPK Cuba memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK)
nphi.summary: Agreement between China CDC and Cuba's tropical medicine institute, both IANPHI members, on tropical disease control, laboratory diagnostics, emergency response and training.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI (WHO Collaborating Centre for AMR)
nphi.with: PAHO; national reference laboratories of ReLAVRA+ member countries
nphi.summary: PAHO network established in 1996 in which Malbrán's INEI has served as regional reference laboratory, building AMR detection and quality-control capacity in national laboratories; it was designated a WHO Collaborating Centre in 2020.

nphi.title: IPK International Course on Dengue, Oropouche and other Emerging Arboviruses
nphi.actor: Institute of Tropical Medicine Pedro Kourí (IPK)
nphi.with: PAHO/WHO Collaborating Center for the Study of Dengue and its Control (at IPK); Cuban Ministry of Public Health
nphi.summary: IPK, a PAHO/WHO collaborating centre for dengue, runs a recurring international course for health professionals from abroad; the 19th edition moved from August 2026 to 2027.

nphi.title: First Conference of G20 National Public Health Institutes (Rio de Janeiro, 2024)
nphi.with: IANPHI; Africa CDC; China CDC; Robert Koch Institute; Cuban NPHI; 20+ IANPHI members
nphi.summary: Under Brazil's G20 presidency, Fiocruz, IANPHI and Africa CDC convened NPHI leaders on emergency preparedness, climate and health, equity and resilient health systems.

nphi.title: Finlay–Pasteur Institute of Iran collaboration on the Soberana 02 COVID-19 vaccine
nphi.summary: Bilateral agreement signed in January 2021 for joint development and clinical evaluation in Iran of Cuba's Soberana 02 conjugate COVID-19 vaccine, complementing the Cuban trials.

nphi.title: Cuban Henry Reeve medical brigade deployment to South Africa for COVID-19
nphi.actor: Ministerio de Salud Pública de Cuba (Henry Reeve Brigade)
nphi.with: South African National Department of Health
nphi.summary: In April 2020 more than 200 Cuban health professionals, including family physicians, epidemiologists and biotechnology experts selected with South Africa's health department, deployed to support the COVID-19 public health response.

nphi.title: Cuban Henry Reeve brigade to Angola for COVID-19
nphi.actor: Ministerio de Salud Pública de Cuba (Henry Reeve Brigade)
nphi.summary: At Angola's request in March 2020, about 256 Henry Reeve brigade health professionals were sent to support the COVID-19 response, adding to more than 800 Cuban health cooperants already working in Angola.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – Cuba National School of Public Health MoU
nphi.with: Escuela Nacional de Salud Pública (ENSAP), Cuba
nphi.summary: MoU between Fiocruz and Cuba's National School of Public Health for cooperation in public health training and research.

nphi.title: CDC–PAHO regional course on influenza molecular diagnostics hosted by InDRE
nphi.actor: US CDC (WHO Collaborating Centre for Influenza)
nphi.with: PAHO/WHO; InDRE (host); National Influenza Centres of participating countries
nphi.summary: International training in August 2018 at Mexico's InDRE for National Influenza Centres and laboratories of 11 countries on PCR-based influenza detection, strengthening the regional GISRS network.

nphi.title: US HHS–Cuba MINSAP memorandum of understanding on health cooperation
nphi.actor: US Department of Health and Human Services
nphi.with: Ministerio de Salud Pública de Cuba (MINSAP)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in June 2016 covering arboviruses (Zika, dengue, chikungunya), NCDs, health security and emergency preparedness, biomedical research and clinical trials, regulation, health IT and professional exchanges.

nphi.title: Brazil–Cuba–Haiti tripartite cooperation to rebuild Haiti's health system
nphi.with: Cuban Ministry of Public Health (medical brigades); Haitian Ministry of Public Health and Population
nphi.summary: Tripartite agreement signed in March 2010 after the earthquake: Brazil financed (R$135 million) facilities, equipment, an epidemiological surveillance centre, vaccination and training, while Cuba provided doctors and technicians.

nphi.title: Gorgas–Cuban partners spatial model of malaria transmission in Madugandí
nphi.actor: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (ICGES)
nphi.with: Centro del Clima (Cuba); Escuela de Salud Pública, Universidad de La Habana
nphi.summary: Joint project with Cuban climate and public health institutions to model the spatial dynamics of malaria transmission in Panama's Madugandí indigenous comarca.

nphi.title: ITM–IPK/INHEM institutional partnership (Belgian DGD framework agreement)
nphi.with: Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK); Instituto Nacional de Higiene, Epidemiología y Microbiología (INHEM)
nphi.summary: Long-running Belgian-funded partnership since around 1999 in which ITM supports Cuba's IPK and INHEM through joint research on tuberculosis and dengue (including community-based dengue control that informed policy), PhD training and…
